goal: Build a Python CLI tool that scans a specified directory for image files (PNG, JPG) and PDF files. It uses a local OCR library (pytesseract) to extract text, then applies regex rules to identify vendor, date, and amount fields. It outputs a structured CSV/JSON file and supports simple tax categorization rules. No external APIs or cloud sync.
acceptance_criteria: CLI tool successfully scans a directory for images/PDFs
Local OCR (pytesseract) extracts text from images
Regex rules identify vendor, date, and amount fields
Output is a structured CSV/JSON file
